page_title: Item:Legendary Bracers of the Unseen Assassin

enchantments.tooltip: Assassinate +16: +16 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Quality Assassinate +3: +3 Quality bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +21 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Deception +12: +12 Enhancement bonus to hit and +18 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
